hero.title: See where your child actually stands among the kids competing for the same places.
hero.subtitle: Monitoring for grade 0–4 pupils preparing for presidential and specialised schools.
hero.sampleCaption: Among 1,240 children aiming for a presidential school

features.title: A range, not a score
features.body: Not a single number but “Top 11–19%”. Every test has error — we don’t hide it.

features.title: Growth across the season
features.body: 8 monitorings from September to spring. The trend says more than any one result.

features.title: One clear next step
features.body: Not ten tips — one task: 15 minutes, three times a week.

hero.footnote: Data is stored on servers inside Uzbekistan · PINFL is never shown on screen

onboarding.title: Welcome to Zinapo, {name}
onboarding.subtitle: Roles aren't separate accounts — they're your relationships with children. Where shall we start?
onboarding.parentBody: I'll add my child. PINFL, grade and school — about a minute.
onboarding.educatorBody: I'll apply. Our team reviews applications, usually within one working day.
onboarding.note: Tutor or staff roles appear here once they are linked to your number. One number, one account.

educatorPending.title: Your application is under review
educatorPending.body: The trust & safety team is reviewing your application. Once it is approved we will message you on Telegram and your tutor workspace opens.
educatorPending.note: In the meantime you can still add your own child as a parent.
